title: AI hardware, Asia demand lift Lufthansa cargo revenue 27%
excerpt: Lufthansa Cargo profit grew behind strong demand in the second quarter, helping to move the airline towards its ambitious goal of becoming one of the three l...
content_html:
Eric Kulisch

Tue, August 4, 2026 at 2:48 PM CDT 5 min read

The cargo division of Deutsche Lufthansa AG (FRA: LHA) posted a 26% gain in adjusted operating profit during the second quarter as strong shipping demand in Asia and from AI-driven cloud service providers, boosted revenue despite volatile market conditions and higher fuel costs associated with the U.S.-Iran war.

In recent months, Lufthansa Cargo launched a full-service, cross-border e-commerce logistics subsidiary through the merger of two in-house companies and completed the first phase of a massive modernization project at its main hub at Frankfurt airport. 

The growth and new investments led Chief Financial Officer Gregor Schleussner on Tuesday to declare that Lufthansa Cargo would return to the top echelon of cargo airlines by the end of the decade. 

"Companies that want to succeed in the long term must be faster, more efficient, and more adaptable than their competitors. This is why we continue to work hard to create the foundation for Lufthansa Cargo's next phase of development through our Bold Moves strategy. Our goal is clear: by 2030, we aim to return to the ranks of the world's top three cargo airlines," he said in a news release issued in conjunction with Group financial results.

Lufthansa Cargo is currently the No. 14 carrier in the world, by traffic volume, according to the International Air Transport Association. It operates 12 Boeing 777 freighter aircraft and is able to market capacity on six 777s operated by AeroLogic, a joint venture between Lufthansa and DHL Express, for a total of 18 widebody freighters under its control. It also manages the belly capacity of sister airlines Lufthansa Airlines, Austrian Airlines, Brussels Airlines, Discover Airlines and SunExpress to transport freight. 

FreightWaves reported on Monday that Lufthansa Cargo has quietly abandoned plans to reinstate four Airbus A321 standard-size freighters pulled from European and North Africa regional service in April. The company didn't provide a reason for souring on the aircraft, but analysts suspect it has to do with operating and market characteristics that make it difficult to fly them at a profit.

Lufthansa Cargo revenue grew 27% during the second quarter to 1 billion euros (equivalent to $1.2 billion). Operating income grew 26% to $1.21 billion, and on an adjusted basis was up 58% to $133.6 million. During the first half, revenue was up 16% and profit margin rose 2.2 points to 10.4%.

Second-quarter demand remained strong, up 3%, despite disruptions and economic uncertainty associated with fighting in the Middle East. Lufthansa benefitted from flight reductions at Middle Eastern competitors such as Emirates and Qatar Airways Cargo and the shift of some ocean freight to air as businesses sought more predictable transport, resulting in a 27% increase in yields, year over year. Fuel surcharges offset fuel expenses and brought in additional revenue, which positively contributed to yields.

content_html_zh:
埃里克·库利什

2026 年 8 月 4 日星期二下午 2:48 CDT 阅读时间 5 分钟

德国汉莎航空公司（法国股票代码：LHA）的货运部门第二季度调整后营业利润增长了 26%，尽管市场状况波动且美伊战争导致燃料成本上升，但亚洲和人工智能驱动的云服务提供商的强劲航运需求增加了收入。

近几个月来，汉莎货运通过合并两家内部公司成立了一家提供全方位服务的跨境电子商务物流子公司，并在法兰克福机场的主要枢纽完成了大规模现代化项目的第一阶段。

增长和新投资促使汉莎货运首席财务官 Gregor Schleussner 周二宣布，汉莎货运将在本世纪末重返货运航空公司的顶级梯队。

“想要长期成功的公司必须比竞争对手更快、更高效、更具适应性。 这就是为什么我们继续努力通过“大胆行动”战略为汉莎货运的下一阶段发展奠定基础。 我们的目标很明确：到2030年，我们的目标是重返世界三大货运航空公司的行列。”他在与集团财务业绩同时发布的新闻稿中表示。

根据国际航空运输协会的数据，按运输量计算，汉莎货运目前是全球第 14 位航空公司。 该公司运营着 12 架波音 777 货机，并能够推销由汉莎航空和 DHL Express 的合资企业 AeroLogic 运营的 6 架 777 的运力，使其控制下的宽体货机总数达到 18 架。 它还管理姐妹航空公司汉莎航空、奥地利航空、布鲁塞尔航空、发现航空和SunExpress 的腹舱运力以运输货物。

FreightWaves 周一报道称，汉莎货运公司已悄然放弃了恢复 4 月份从欧洲和北非区域服务中撤出的四架空客 A321 标准尺寸货机的计划。 该公司没有提供飞机质量不佳的原因，但分析师怀疑这与运营和市场特征有关，这些特征导致飞机难以盈利。

汉莎航空货运第二季度收入增长 27%，达到 10 亿欧元（相当于 12 亿美元）。 营业收入增长 26% 至 12.1 亿美元，调整后增长 58% 至 1.336 亿美元。 上半年，收入增长16%，利润率增长2.2个百分点，达到10.4%。

尽管中东战斗造成干扰和经济不确定性，但第二季度需求仍然强劲，增长了 3%。 汉莎航空受益于阿联酋航空和卡塔尔航空货运等中东竞争对手的航班减少，以及由于企业寻求更可预测的运输而将部分海运转向空运，导致收益率同比增长 27%。 燃油附加费抵消了燃油费用并带来了额外收入，对收益率产生了积极贡献。
